constraints.definition: CHECK (((category IS NULL) OR ((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM category)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM category)) <= 120))))

constraints.name: services_city_length_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((city IS NULL) OR ((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM city)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM city)) <= 160))))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((service_lat IS NULL) AND (service_lng IS NULL)) OR ((service_lat IS NOT NULL) AND (service_lng IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: services_country_length_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((country IS NULL) OR ((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM country)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM country)) <= 120))))

constraints.name: services_identity_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK (((image_url IS NULL) OR ((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM image_url)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM image_url)) <= 2000))))

constraints.name: services_latitude_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((service_lat IS NULL) OR ((service_lat >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (service_lat <= (90)::double precision))))

constraints.name: services_location_length_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((location IS NULL) OR ((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM location)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM location)) <= 300))))

constraints.name: services_longitude_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((service_lng IS NULL) OR ((service_lng >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (service_lng <= (180)::double precision))))

constraints.name: services_subcategory_length_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((subcategory IS NULL) OR ((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM subcategory)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM subcategory)) <= 160))))

constraints.name: services_title_length_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) >= 2) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) <= 140)))
